d: Eun Ho and Jun Hwa take action to save the imprisoned Deok Su, who believes Seol Mae Hwa is behind this.
Deok Su returns with a plan to reclaim her place at Yongcheonru and declares war on Seol Mae Hwa.
Deok Su's plan succeeds and receives the approval of Yongcheonru's owner, while Seol Mae Hwa is in distress.
Eun Ho is bothered by Deok Su and Jun Hwa's closeness. Deok Su's mother visits at Master Cheon's request.
Deok Su vows revenge against Master Cheon, while Eun Ho accepts an arranged engagement to further his plan.
Eun Ho and Deok Su clash over the golden keys but eventually make a pact to work together.
Eun Ho and Deok Su confirm their mutual feelings, and he vows to protect her, while Jun Hwa is heartbroken.
Deok Su is shocked by Eun Ho's royal identity. Now, the prince must confront those who are after the ledger.
Deok Su deceives Master Cheon to execute her revenge, but Jun Hwa obeys his father's orders to stop her.
Eun Ho reveals the ugly truth of the past to the world. A new era of kings begins.
Yong Ju’s sales branch faces closure, while Min Ju quietly brews Naro Beer in the countryside.
Tasked with saving the branch, Yong Ju is sent to recruit Min Ju, whom she recognises from a past encounter.
Yong Ju’s persistence begins to wear on Min Ju. Meanwhile, a town meeting is set to reveal shocking news.
Yong Ju refuses to exploit Min Ju despite the villagers’ hostility, while the beer festival falls into chaos.
Yong Ju's heroic act deeply moves Min Ju, and they uncover a rival’s cheating scheme and Ah Reum’s secret.
A change in business strategy disrupts their beer project, and Yong Ju suspects internal sabotage.
Min Ju falls for Yong Ju, but guilt over her grandmother’s condition drives him into isolation.
Yong Ju struggles with her feelings while Min Ju waits patiently. Jealousy surfaces when his ex appears.
Yong Ju grows closer to Min Ju as she grieves her grandmother, while an outsider returns with hidden motives.
Yong Ju and Min Ju's beer lineup fails internal evaluation, prompting them to push a bold revival plan.
Disputes over beer inconsistencies strain Yong Ju and Min Ju’s relationship, leading to escalating chaos.
Yong Ju tackles online sabotage and achieves sales success before contemplating her next step.
Gi Bbeum and Ma Seong meet by chance, and they promised to see each other again, but an accident happens.
Ma Seong is confused when he keeps thinking about Gi Bbeum's face so he instructs the secretary to find her.
The doctor tells Ma Seong that he seems to be in love. Ki Joon tries to scout Gi Bbeum to his company.
Gi Bbeum is forced to sign a contract with an entertainment company because of her father.
Ma Seong side with Ha Im when Gi Bbeum has a quarrel with her, Gi Bbeum said she regrets meeting Ma Seong.
Gi Bbeum with Aquaphobia appears on entertainment shows and is criticized by the public again.
Gi Bbeum asks Ma Seong, who helped her, to have dinner with her.
Gi Bbeum gets angry at Ma Seong who didn’t show up again, she is jealous that Ma Seong is with Ha Im.
Gi Bbeum realized that Ma Seong couldn’t come to meet her in Hainan because of the accident.
Ma Seong and Gi Bbeum finally start dating and Jin Yang goes to the house of Gi Bbeum to humiliate her father.
Ha Im asks Ki Joon to marry her. Jin Yang convenes an emergency board meeting to bring Ma Seong's dismissal.
Beom Soo asks police to reinvestigate the case of Hyeong Joon's death, Gi Bbeum receives a call from police.
Ma Seong promises to Gi Bbeum, who went to the prosecution's investigation, that he will protect her.
Ma Seong suspects that the accident three years ago may not be a coincidence.
Ma Seong decides to break up with Gi Bbeum and he shows tears as he greets Gi Bbeum, who is going to LA.
Gi Bbeum waits for Ma Seong who has left and a letter arrives at Gi Bbeum.
Wang Won, the crown prince of the Goryeo Dynasty, visits Lee Seung Hyu with his friend Wang Rin.
As it gets dark, Wang Won and Wang Rin spend a night in a cave with Eun San.
Wang Jeon asks permission of Eun Yeong Baek, the father of Eun San, to marry her.
Wang Won tries to find the one who shot an arrow at King Chung Ryeol to prove Wang Rin's innocence.
Due to Song In's trick, Eun San is caught as one of the attackers of the King's assassination.
Song In gets to know Eun San's identity and forces her to marry Wang Jeon.
While Wang Rin tries hard to mar Eun San's marriage talks, Wang Won senses the uneasy atmosphere.
King Chung Ryeol becomes furious when he hears that Wang Won interfered in Wang Jeon's marriage.
Wang Rin puts up himself to save his sister Wang Dan.
Princess Won Seong and Song In capture Eun Yeong Baek and Eun San, coveting their property.
To provide support, Princess Won Seong fetches Lee Seung Hyu for Wang Won.
Wang Won comes up against King Chung Ryeol to get back Eun San.
To stop Eun San from leaving, Wang Won reinvestigates the Sungjookjae incident.
Princess Won Seong orders Eun San to testify on the Sungjookjae incident to ruin Wang Rin's family.
Wang Rin wants to protect Eun San, who is devastated at her father's death.
Wang Rin and Eun San are chased by Jang Ui, Princess Won Seong's men, and King Chung Ryeol's men.
Wang Rin announces that he would marry Eun San but Wang Won detains Rin and brings San to his place.
Discovering the truth of Princess Won Seong's death, Wang Won loses his temper.
Wang Won gets to know Wang Rin's real intention and gains powerful political position with his help.
Wang Won, Wang Rin, and Eun San makes their own resolution to save Goryeo from Yuan.
Hong Deok Su and Prince Mu Yeong join Yongcheonru as apprentices, each with their own hidden motives.
Disguised as Lee Eun Ho, the prince keeps a close eye on Deok Su as he attempts to retrieve the golden key.
A murder involving a forged certificate raises tensions, while the quartet struggles to pass their exams.
Jun Hwa discovers Deok Su's secret by accident. Eun Ho and Deok Su develop subtle feelings for each other.
